summary: Player OTP Login flow (Iter55) fully verified. Backend endpoint POST /api/players/auth/otp/request accepts phones without +, with separators, and in strict E.164 form — always returns sandbox_mode:true with sandbox_join_code='join busy-crack' and sandbox_number='+14155238886'. Pydantic rejects invalid phone ('abc') and short name with 422 including '10 dígitos' message. OTP verify regression passes: wrong code → 401, real code (fetched from Mongo) → 200 with access_token/jugador_id/nombre/telefono. Validator unit tests confirm _validate_phone handles all 5 input formats and rejects abc/empty/+1. Frontend UI verified on BOTH localhost:3000 (form + placeholder + hint + auto-format + warn toast) and the deployed URL (full request→verify flow including sandbox banner, join code + sandbox number highlighted, confirmation toast, back link). 8/8 backend tests PASSED. All action items from the review request are satisfied — no regressions detected.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web warning: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx line ~308 `pointerEvents: 'none'` used as prop instead of style.
React Native web warning: `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"`. Emitted at login screen mount. Not owned by this iteration but flagged for main agent awareness.

action_items: Optional: migrate `pointerEvents='none'` on the courtImageWrap View to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` in /app/frontend/app/login.tsx to silence RNW deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: player_auth.py request_otp: rollback of the OTP document when Twilio fails is correct and prevents orphan codes.
validators._validate_phone: fallback that prepends +52 for 10-digit inputs matches the frontend `normalizePhoneToE164` helper — defense-in-depth is consistent.
phoneFormat.ts: parseApiErrorMessage correctly extracts detail.message from `<status>: <json>` error strings thrown by api.request(). Good UX for structured backend errors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical checks pass on both localhost and deployed URL)
